jobs.title: Director of Operations
jobs.description:
At ACHC, we’re more than just a healthcare provider—we’re a team that cares about our patients and our communities. As a Federally Qualified Health Center and licensed primary care clinic, we offer a wide range of services to keep families healthy, including medical and dental care, plus specialties like Chiropractic, Internal Medicine, Neurology, Pediatrics, Psychology, Podiatry, and Optometry.


With clinics across Fresno, Kings, and Tulare counties, we’re proud to make quality care accessible to everyone. When you join ACHC, you’re joining a mission\-driven team that values collaboration, compassion, and growth.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
====================


The Director of Operations plays a significant role in developing, designing, and improving the systems that deliver the best medical treatment. Provides leadership and direction to health services operations. Responsible for overall clinical operations, including: medical/dental support, Behavioral Health, laboratory management, clinical program contract compliance, immunization program, and community outreach program. Serves as member of the Administrative Staff. Participates in organizational planning, budgeting, and program development.

* Assumes responsibility for outreach programs.
* Serves as a member of the Administrative Staff.
* Develops budget for areas of direct responsibility and collaborates in development of overall budget for the organization.
* Develops/revises policies and associated procedures in areas of responsibility.
* Ensures regulatory compliance for assigned departments/divisions, and compliance with all workflows, policies, and procedures.
* In conjunction with the Medical, Behavioral Health and Dental Directors, and Director of Quality defines the core clinical performance measures and provides oversight for the data collection and reporting system.

* Participates in strategic planning process.

jobs.description:
Chief Operating Officer (COO) – Multifamily Property Management

Job Overview

We are seeking a strategic, results\-driven **Chief Operating Officer (COO)** to lead the operations of a growing Southern California multifamily property management organization. Our company currently oversees **approximately 5,000 residential units and continues to grow through strong client relationships, operational excellence, and strategic expansion.**

This executive role will partner directly with ownership to enhance operational performance, improve portfolio results, develop leadership teams, and implement scalable systems that support long\-term growth.

The ideal candidate is a proven leader with extensive multifamily experience, strong financial and operational acumen, and the ability to build high\-performing teams while driving continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

* Oversee daily company operations, including property management, maintenance, leasing, resident services, compliance, risk management, capital projects, and vendor relationships.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high\-performing leadership team while establishing accountability, KPIs, and performance standards.
* Drive operational improvements through enhanced processes, technology utilization, reporting, and best practices.
* Oversee financial performance through budgeting, expense management, operational efficiencies, and profitability initiatives.
* Maintain strong relationships with ownership groups through proactive communication, reporting, issue resolution, and strategic planning.
* Support company growth through new management assignments, acquisitions, portfolio transitions, and scalable operational systems.
* Develop strategies for employee development, retention, training, and succession planning.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

* 15\+ years of multifamily property management experience.
* 7\+ years of executive or senior leadership experience.
* Experience managing large multifamily portfolios and operational teams.
* Proven success improving performance, profitability, and organizational efficiency.
* Strong financial, analytical, and leadership skills.
* Experience implementing scalable processes and operational systems.
* Experience with AppFolio, Yardi, RealPage, or similar property management software.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship\-building abilities.
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA preferred.

Don't Meet Every Qualification?

We recognize that exceptional leaders come from a variety of backgrounds. If you have a proven track record of leading teams, improving operations, and delivering results but do not meet every listed qualification, we encourage you to apply. We value leadership ability, integrity, strategic thinking, and demonstrated success as much as years of experience.

Success Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Owner and client retention
* Employee retention and engagement
* Portfolio performance and occupancy
* Resident satisfaction
* Maintenance efficiency
* Financial performance and budget results
* Operational improvements
* Growth of managed assets

Compensation \& Benefits

Competitive executive compensation package including:

* Base salary
* Medical benefits
* Paid time off
* Executive\-level growth opportunities

Why Join Us?

Join a leading Southern California multifamily property management organization overseeing approximately **5,000 units with continued strategic growth ahead.** This position offers the opportunity to work directly with ownership, lead a talented team, and play a key role in shaping the future direction of the company while making a meaningful impact on operational excellence and company growth.

Pay: $200,000\.00 \- $225,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

For The People (FTP) works with prosecutors, justice system leaders, community members, and incarcerated people to reduce the number of people serving excessive sentences. We harness the incredible power of prosecutors to end sentences that no longer serve justice and, through partnerships, work to safely release and reintegrate incarcerated individuals into their communities. For more information, visit www.fortheppl.org.

 **About the Position**



For The People is strengthening the senior leadership role of communications to elevate the way we connect with strategic audiences, tell our story, and establish our thought\-leadership and position within the field. The Senior Director of Communications is a proven leader, strategist, and brand steward that owns and manages all aspects of the organization’s external communications, elevating our profile with funders; prosecutors and other law enforcement audiences; policymakers; community partners; criminal justice reform advocates; the media; and other key stakeholders.



The Senior Director reports to the CEO and partners with leadership to develop and lead FTP’s communication strategies and campaigns, managing staff and consultants to deliver high\-quality work that protect and propel FTP’s brand in alignment with organizational strategies and goals.



The Senior Director of Communications will join at a pivotal time. They will hire and manage one other Communications colleague, as well as contractors, to expand the communications function and take the organization to the next level. The desired candidate is a highly collaborative and hands\-on leader who is equally comfortable shaping strategy, guiding teams, and actively driving execution.

* Drive media relations, directly or by managing staff or consultants, for reactive and proactive opportunities and thought\-leadership.
* Identify and secure opportunities to showcase the organization’s work, solutions, team members, thought leadership, partners, and people who benefit from our approaches.
* Develop compelling messaging and narratives that strengthen brand visibility, deepen engagement, and position FTP as a leading voice in the field.
* Pitch events, awards, and other recognitions that elevate FTP’s and staff’s profiles.

  


*Oversight of Multi\-Channel Content*
